# CBOR-Web — The Binary Protocol for AI Agents

> Open protocol (RFC 8949) that makes websites machine-readable. 100× cheaper, 95% signal ratio, cryptographic identity built in. 8 SDKs, 38 sites live.

## Docs

- [README](../../README.md) — Project overview, architecture, comparison table, quick start
- [CBOR-WEB-CORE.md](../../CBOR-WEB-CORE.md) — Full specification: manifest, pages, content blocks, access control
- [CBOR-WEB-SECURITY.md](../../CBOR-WEB-SECURITY.md) — DoS protection, CORS, rate limiting, production checklist
- [CBOR-WEB-REFERENCE.md](../../CBOR-WEB-REFERENCE.md) — Reference data, constants, enumerations
- [CBOR-WEB-MULTIMEDIA.md](../../CBOR-WEB-MULTIMEDIA.md) — Images, audio, video handling in CBOR blocks
- [CBOR-WEB-GENERATIVE.md](../../CBOR-WEB-GENERATIVE.md) — AI-specific fields, prompts, model hints
- [CBOR-WEB-ECONOMICS.md](../../CBOR-WEB-ECONOMICS.md) — Token economics, billing model, pricing
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) — How to contribute: PR guidelines, issue templates
- [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) — Vulnerability reporting, security policy
